Name: (CP) Brown Tabby Cat
Author: plesiosaur44
Description:
This is a simple Content Patcher-based mod that changes the gray tabby cat to a brown tabby cat. My irl cat is a brown tabby and I wanted a cat that looked like her. The closest I could find was [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1841]BrassyDel's Brown Tabby Mod[/url], which was both too fluffy and an older .xnb mod. This retexture uses the colors off of their mod, so all credit to them for the colors!

[b][size=3]Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list][b][size=3]Installation:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download and unzip/extract into the Mods folder
[*]Run your game with SMAPI and you should be good to go!﻿
[/list]
